title: System Metrics
description: CPU, GPU, memory, disk, and network — devbox + llmserver

list.name: gpu
list.label: GPU
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "sysmetrics", tag: "gpu", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "gpu" and r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sysmetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "usage_pct")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "sysmetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_c")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "sysmetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "freq_mhz")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "sysmetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.gpu =~ /^${gpu:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "_field", "host", "gpu"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "gpu_util_pct")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "sysmetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.gpu =~ /^${gpu:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "_field", "host", "gpu"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "vram_used_mb")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "sysmetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)

  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "_field", "host", "gpu"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "vram_total_mb")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "total")

panels.title: GPU Power W — sysmetrics vs LLM requests

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sysmetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.gpu =~ /^${gpu:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "_field", "host", "gpu"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "power_w")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "llm")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "llm_request")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "gpu_avg_watts")
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "llm_avg [" + r.host + "]"}))
  |> yield(name: "llm_avg")

from(bucket: "llm")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "llm_request")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "gpu_peak_watts")
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "llm_peak [" + r.host + "]"}))
  |> yield(name: "llm_peak")

from(bucket: "sysmetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "power_w")
  |> group(columns: ["host", "gpu"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "all GPUs [" + r.host + "]"}))
  |> yield(name: "total")
